matchedComparison.scope: 26 controlled questions with identical v29/revised evidence and drafts; two alternating trials per implementation. Frozen v29 verifier/recovery/final citation gate, common unchanged extraction/source-brief helpers; not full old/new APK or general web accuracy.
matchedComparison.memoryScope: After-call process samples, not transient peak memory or causal allocation reduction.
matchedComparison.literalMarkerScope: The raw expectedFact flag is exact substring matching and undercounts some paraphrases; it is not used as semantic fact recall.

nativeComparison.scope: One actual CPU generation per question, same draft and token-counted prepared evidence assessed by both versions. Synthetic controlled facts, no extra judge-model generation.

appearance.imageGeneration: Built-in image tool; final prompt and project path documented in VERIFICATION.md

limits: Bounded deterministic vocabulary and relationship templates, not universal semantic entailment. No new search/extraction engine, judge model, GPU/NPU performance, battery or transient-peak-memory claim. Missing or blocked publisher evidence cannot be manufactured.
